user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error when my password is shorter than 8 characters so that I use a secure password.

positive.title: User receives an error when password is shorter than 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password input field on the signup page.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is too short.

negative.title: User successfully sets a password with 8 or more characters
steps: Navigate to the password input field on the signup page.
Enter a password with 8 or more characters.
negative.expected_result: The form is submitted successfully without any error message related to password length.

edge.title: User attempts to set an empty password
steps: Navigate to the password input field on the signup page.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password cannot be empty.
